explanation: Asks whether there are infinitely many balanced primes. It is encoded as infinitely many n with (p_n + p_{n+2})/2 prime. The only prime strictly between p_n and p_{n+2} is p_{n+1}, so primality of the midpoint forces p_{n+1} = (p_n + p_{n+2})/2. The one spurious case is n = 0, where 7/2 truncates to 3, which does not affect infinitude. The statement is faithful to Wikipedia's open problem.
